title: I ruined my cats’ toilet time with a motion-activated neon litter box sign
summary: One USB-powered neon sign later, and the deed was done. Whenever either Noodle or Loaf steps into our living room litter box, the sensor turns on the sign, letting anyone around know that they are, ahem, on air.
